column1: # workflow_panelB.tsv: what panel B of docs/img/workflow.png draws (read by docs/img/src/workflow.py)
# source: cenfuse 0.16.0 benchmark, FASTA-only runs of rice (Oryza sativa, T2T Nipponbare) and tomato
#   (Solanum lycopersicum, Heinz 1706); assemblies and accessions in docs/benchmark.md
# made from each run's satellite folder: arrays of the families the satellite engine called centromeric (annotate/
#   <genome>.arrays.tsv, centromeres/<genome>.families.tsv), merged into clusters of arrays within merge_gap_bp
#   (cenfuse.sat.classify.make_clusters); the one-per-chromosome test and its 10,000 random draws are
#   cenfuse.sat.karyotype.satellite_test and null_covered (seeded). Checked against the release's test results.
# coordinates: bp, 0-based half-open (as the satellite engine's arrays)
# kind: chromosome (name = chromosome, end = its length, in drawing order) | cluster, largest (name = chromosome,
#   value = satellite bp in the cluster; largest = the N largest, N = chromosomes: the ones the test counts) |
#   chance (start = chromosomes covered, value = random draws of 10,000) | test (name = field, value)
